osintX.content:
Daily Ukraine map thread for Wednesday 25th November 2026

There's no shortage of Russian publications asking you to Avert your eyes from reality. We're here to do precisely the opposite today

Small map focus today on western Zaporizhzhia and Donetsk, where Russian forces continue throwing men and equipment into the furnace for the magnificent return of precisely nothing.

As casualties mount, territorial gains remain conspicuously absent. An extraordinary amount of blood is being spilt for an army seemingly incapable of moving the map.

Unfortunately for Russia, the Rosstat leaks are now available to download and examine, with early analysis suggesting losses considerably worse than even our own estimates.

Remember, behind every figure is a human being, and casualties occur on both sides. But every Ukrainian casualty is also an opportunity to get another soldier back on their feet and into the fight. Earlier, we shared a fundraiser for one of the finest medics serving with the 53rd Mechanised Brigade.

Our support helps ensure Ukrainian soldiers receive the treatment, equipment and supplies needed to recover and return to their comrades. Ukraine is fortunate to have outstanding medical personnel, blessed with considerable expertise, generous proportions of compassion and, thanks to your donations, rather ample equipment.

Not that Russia appears similarly fortunate in the medical department. Its soldiers could only dream of the supplies, expertise and rather considerable advantages enjoyed by their Ukrainian counterparts. Some disparities in this war are simply impossible to overlook.

Switching to northern Kharkiv, Russian infiltrators following Operation Bear Trap have resorted to flag-raising exercises to demonstrate territorial control. The small problem? Infiltrators have no supporting force, no reliable evacuation and precious little medical support. Once spotted, their chances of survival are decidedly limited.
